title: The Florence 2.0
description:
Welcome to The Florence | A fresh, roomy townhome that has it all, right where you want to be! Located in East Nashville, we're a 5 min ride from everything downtown has to offer. The home is fully equipped; just bring your suitcase and your spirit of adventure! The Florence is aesthetically decorated in the Art Deco style mixed with an ode to Nashville flair! Once inside, make sure to pick your favorite room: The Dolly Parton, The David Bowie, The Taylor Swift or The Elton John.

The space
The bedrooms and one bath are upstairs and the laundry second bath are on the main level.

Guest access
Whole home

Other things to note
Dogs are welcome, but we ask that you put them on your reservation. Limit to 2 total and they be crated while you are away. Please no pets on the furniture, as any damages or excessive cleaning is subject to an additional fee starting at $100. Pet fee is $50/pet.
